summary: US and Israel discussed a joint strike on Iran while Iran warned this may be the "last night of normality" in the Middle East; Kuwait intercepted an Iranian missile attack and the US EUCOM commander warned of insufficient naval forces to defend Israel. Trump claimed a preliminary deal framework with Iran including immediate full opening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to nuclear threats, with Saudi mediation. Meanwhile, IDF destroyed five Hamas weapon depots in Gaza and eliminated Hezbollah operatives in southern Lebanon, wounding an officer.
key_points: US and Israel discussed joint strike on Iran; Iran warns "last night of normality"; Kuwait intercepts Iranian missile attack. (Source: @yediotnews25/133477, @asafroz/52175, @VahidOnline/77695)

Trump says agreed to cancel attack on Iran after preliminary deal framework: immediate full opening of Strait of Hormuz, end nuclear threat; Israel joins commitment. (Source: @amitsegal/63550, @mamlekate/104059)
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed five Hamas weapon depots across Gaza overnight, one near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @idf_telegram/24802, @shin_persian/8771)
IDF eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists in Ali Taher ridge area in southern Lebanon; one officer moderately wounded. (Source: @inon_yttach/9775, @yediotnews25/133471)

Iranian suicide drones attacked Kurdish opposition headquarters in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq; warplanes fly low over Kurdistan Region. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86685, @lelotsenzura/94024, @naya_foriraq/86692)

US EUCOM commander Gen. Grynkewich warns Pentagon of insufficient naval forces to defend Israel from ballistic missiles; only two warships in eastern Mediterranean, one in Red Sea. (Source: @asafroz/52184)
Iranian cyberattacks hit water infrastructure in at least seven US states; no water supply altered. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5999)
Saudi Crown Prince expressed concern to Trump about massive attack plan on Iran, asked for "plan of action". (Source: @N12chat/220201)

Trump claimed a preliminary deal framework with Iran including immediate full opening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to nuclear threats, with Saudi mediation. points: Iranian cyberattacks have hit water infrastructure systems in at least seven different US states, according to US officials cited by the Wall Street Journal, though no water supply has been altered or made unsafe. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5999)

Iran's Foreign Ministry declared the country will continue its "powerful defense" against what it calls illegal US-Israeli attacks under the leadership of Ayatollah Seyed Mojtaba Khamenei, defending sovereignty, international law, and shared moral values. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6008)

Foreign Minister Araghchi stated Iran is ready to decisively respond to any "aggression" and warned the US against any "adventurist action" in calls with the Turkish Foreign Minister and Pakistani Army commander. (Source: @kianmeli1/90500)
A launcher device was reported in a residential area of Izeh city in Iran, indicating possible military preparations or defensive positioning. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78523)
Gasoline queues formed at stations in Tehran, including on Shariati Street at Bahar intersection, as citizens fear escalation and potential war. (Source: @kianmeli1/90511, @lelotsenzura/94023)
The US dollar approached 196,000 tomans in Iran's unofficial market, with Telegram channels linking the surge to "probability of war." (Source: @mamlekate/104058)

Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned US maritime blockade, threats to civilian infrastructure, and silence of the UN Security Council, calling US actions "clear aggression" and violation of UN Charter. (Source: @SharghDaily/175699)

IDF and Shin Bet destroyed five Hamas weapon depots across Gaza overnight, including one near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah, containing Kalashnikov rifles, explosives, anti-tank launchers, ammunition, and military equipment intended for attacks on IDF forces along the "yellow line" and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24802, @shin_persian/8771)

IDF eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists in the Ali Taher ridge area in southern Lebanon during operational activity; one IDF officer was moderately wounded and evacuated to hospital. (Source: @inon_yttach/9775, @yediotnews25/133471, @yediotnews25/133477)

Israel raised defense alert status due to regional tension, with US embassies across the Middle East warning citizens of unexpected escalation, urging them to consider leaving and prepare for flight disruptions. (Source: @yediotnews25/133476, @yediotnews25/133477)
US and Israeli officials discussed a joint strike on Iran; the White House posted "God bless our soldiers," signaling heightened readiness. (Source: @yediotnews25/133477, @yediotnews25/133473)

Trump claimed he agreed to cancel an attack on Iran after reaching a preliminary deal framework including immediate, full, and complete opening of the Strait of Hormuz and ending Iran's nuclear threat, with Israel joining the commitment. (Source: @amitsegal/63550)
A reservist NCO was found dead in southern Israel; the IDF opened a military police investigation, circumstances still under examination. (Source: @pkpoi/143495)

US EUCOM commander Gen. Alexus Grynkewich warned the Pentagon he lacks sufficient naval forces to continue defending Israel from ballistic missile attacks, with only two warships in the eastern Mediterranean and one in the Red Sea. (Source: @asafroz/52184)

Five Hamas weapon depots were destroyed in overnight Israeli airstrikes across Gaza, the IDF and Shin Bet announced; one depot was located next to Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @shin_persian/8771, @idf_telegram/24802)

The depots held assault rifles, explosive devices, anti-tank launchers, ammunition, and additional military equipment, intended for terrorist attacks against IDF forces operating near the "yellow line" and against Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24802)

The IDF stated the depot near Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital served as a shelter for Hamas terrorists who stored weapons there, citing it as another example of Hamas's systematic use of civilian infrastructure, including medical facilities, for terror activities. (Source: @idf_telegram/24802)
IDF forces under Southern Command remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue acting to remove all threats. (Source: @idf_telegram/24802)
A massive explosion occurred in the town of Kounin in South Lebanon; the cause remains unknown as of reporting. (Source: @SharghDaily/175709)

IDF forces identified and eliminated several Hezbollah terrorists in the Ali Taher ridge area within the security zone where IDF operates; the engagement resulted in one IDF officer moderately wounded. (Source: @inon_yttach/9775, @yediotnews25/133471)
Drone flight was observed over Qana, Al-Ghaziyah, and surrounding areas at low altitude, indicating continued aerial surveillance or operational activity. (Source: @redlinkleb/34234)

US embassies in the Middle East warned citizens of unexpected escalation, urging them to consider departure and prepare for flight disruptions and cancellations in the region. (Source: @yediotnews25/133477)
Suicide drones attacked headquarters of the Kurdish opposition in Sulaymaniyah governorate, northern Iraq, attributed to Iranian forces. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86685, @lelotsenzura/94024)
US Air Force aircraft were observed flying over northern Iraq, indicating continued US aerial presence. (Source: @shin_persian/8767)
Interception attempts were reported over Erbil, Iraq, suggesting active air defense engagements. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94025)
Warplanes at low altitude were seen flying over cities in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86692)
US forces deployed at Ain al-Asad base in western Iraq then moved toward the Nukhayb desert area, according to a security source cited by the New York Times. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78514)

Kuwait's army announced interception of a missile attack from Iran; air defense systems engaged hostile drones following what Kuwait called "criminal Iranian aggression," advising civilians to follow safety instructions. (Source: @asafroz/52175, @VahidOnline/77695)
Six US tanker aircraft were tracked over the Middle East, signaling increased aerial refueling capacity for potential operations. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94009)
The British Maritime Trade Centre reported another attack against a vessel sailing the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz near Oman. (Source: @asafroz/52174)
The Houthis denied reports they intend to charge transit fees for ships passing through the Bab al-Mandeb strait. (Source: @asafroz/52172)
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman expressed concern to Trump about a massive attack plan on Iran and asked for the "plan of action," according to Barak Ravid. (Source: @N12chat/220201)

Trump stated the US attack on Iran was halted after a call with Bin Salman; Iran and other Middle East countries requested a delay as they reached understanding on a framework including immediate full opening of the Strait of Hormuz and ending Iran's nuclear threat. (Source: @mamlekate/104059)
